# Agent Journal (structured notes)
<!-- sections: ## Findings | ## Leads | ## Questions | ## Decisions -->
<!-- injected into every prompt — write here what future-you must know -->

## Findings
- Task (TASK.md): pytest issue #10060 — `--pdb` runs `tearDown()` of `unittest.TestCase`
  classes decorated with class-level `unittest.skip`. Fixed in `src/_pytest/unittest.py`
  `TestCaseFunction.runtest`: the #7215 guard only checked `_is_skipped(self.obj)`
  (the test function), not the class. Fix (matches upstream bd642fac7):
  `skipped = _is_skipped(self.obj) or _is_skipped(self.parent.obj)`.
- Verified: repro (class-skip + tearDown raising NameError) gives `sE`/error before,
  clean `1 skipped` after; without `--pdb` unchanged.
- Environment gotchas (pre-existing, NOT caused by fix):
  - venv at stack/campaign/.venv; its `_pytest_repo_src.pth` points at a
    DIFFERENT checkout (pytest-7205-nopanel/src). Run tests with
    `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src` from this repo (pytest-10081-panel) to test THIS tree.
  - `src/_pytest/_version.py` was missing (gitignored build artifact); regenerated
    via setuptools_scm (7.2.0.dev173+gda9a2b584).
  - Suite on Python 3.12: conftest import dies under `filterwarnings=error`
    (`ast.Str` DeprecationWarning from old assertion/rewrite.py) -> use `-p no:warnings`.
  - Pre-existing failures (identical with fix stashed): test_unittest.py
    test_function_item_obj_is_instance, test_setup_inheritance_skipping[both],
    test_pdb_teardown_called (asserts `* 2 passed in *` but py3.12 prints
    `2 passed, 2 warnings`); test_debugging.py::test_pdb_unittest_skip (pexpect).
  - Full test_unittest.py: 4 failed, 58 passed, 9 skipped — same baseline before/after.

## Decisions
- Minimal source-only fix; no test/changelog changes (TASK.md forbids test edits,
  asks for minimal fix, no commit).
